body.text:
2 more MacBook tips!💻👇

1. Claude Cowork now also works with scheduled tasks 👨🏼‍💻 This allows you to fully automate anything you can do with Claude Cowork, so Claude can work for you around the clock!
2. Claude also connects to tools like Notion, Apple Notes & more 🔥 This allows Claude to work where you work and gives your existing workspaces a huge boost!

You can get started with @claudeai through the link in my bio!🙂‍↕️

This video is sponsored by Anthropic, the team behind Claude. #claudepartner
